author: TEDx Talks
description:
Clinical trials drive medical breakthroughs, but medical mistrust has led to limited participation amongst some groups. Johnson’s talk discusses why participation is important. Leigh Johnson, MPH, HEO, is a Research Scientist at the NYU Clinical and Translational Science Institute. 

This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Your participation in clinical trials matters—here’s why | Leigh Johnson | TEDxNYU Langone Health
